data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Tamil language and means 'great' or 'big'. It is a unisex name and is used in both the Tamil and Hindi cultures. The name Periya carries the meaning “Great, Big” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Tamil, Hindi. Parents who choose Periya usually hope their child will grow to embody great, big and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Periya belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great, Big.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Periya total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

Also, since it is considered a grand and noble name, it is often given as a title of respect to revered elders and veteran leaders in the community.
